title: A Training Criterion with Token-Level Tolerance to Transcription Ambiguity for Automatic Speech Recognition
authors: S. Kumar, D. Mohanta, P. K. Ghosh
note: Developed token-level Omni-temporal Classification (OTC) for robust ASR training under transcript ambiguity, achieving a **9.45% average relative WER reduction** over CTC across 19 languages, 3 corpora, and 25 tasks. Introduced hybrid token- and word-level wildcard paths and an entropy-based relaxation schedule to improve transcription robustness and reduce dependence on training duration.

title: Complex AFNet: A Hybrid Complex-Valued Deep Network for Atrial Fibrillation Detection
authors: P. S. P. K. Mahali, D. Mohanta, T. Sandhan
note: A hybrid real/complex-valued architecture modelling phase–magnitude structure in Gramian Angular Field representations of ECG for atrial fibrillation detection.
